div.head: II Em Prol. 2
div.ab: Me eleð swyðe ⁊ us eallum ða unrihtlican ⁊ mænigfealdan gefeoht, ðe betwux us sylfum syndan; þonne cwæde we:
Me egleð swyðe ⁊ us eallum ða unrihtlican ⁊ mænigfealdan gefeoht, ðe betwux us sylfum syndun; ðonne cwæde we:
Et mihi ualde displicent et nobis omnibus multiplices et iniuste pugne, que inter nos ipsos fiunt (fuerint); unde diximus:
Me egleð swyðe ⁊ us eallum þa unrihtlican ⁊ mænigfealdan gefeoht ðe betwux us sylfum syndun; ðonne cwæde we:
I myself and all of us are greatly distressed by the manifold illegal deeds of violence which are in our midst. We have therefore decreed:
The illegal and manifold conflicts which take place among us distress me and all of us greatly. We decreed then:
Mich und uns alle verdriessen sehr die ungesetzlichen und mannigfachen Fehden, die zwischen uns sind; nun bestimmten wir:
The unlawful and manifold feuds that exist among us greatly displease me and all of us; now we have determined:
